mapper.sql: url_id AS urlId, request_headers AS requestHeaders, query_params AS queryParams, success_resp_example AS successRespExample, fail_resp_example AS failRespExample, remark, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, del_flag AS delFlag
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_url_doc (url_id, request_headers, query_params, success_resp_example, fail_resp_example, remark, del_flag) VALUES (#{urlId}, #{requestHeaders}, #{queryParams}, #{successRespExample}, #{failRespExample}, #{remark}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE request_headers = VALUES(request_headers), query_params = VALUES(query_params), success_resp_example = VALUES(success_resp_example), fail_resp_example = VALUES(fail_resp_example), remark = VALUES(remark), del_flag = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM api_url_doc WHERE url_id = #{urlId} AND del_flag = 0
